title: Stable Diffusion on iOS native
summary: The surprisingly non-straightforward port of Stable Diffusion to iOS

body.raw:
_Author's note: This was one of the first posts I wrote for this blog, but I didn't take the time to actually publish my blog until now.
I finished the project on September 9th, making it, to my best knowledge, the first port of Stable Diffusion to iOS.
There are multiple ports now, but I'm still proud to do a truly original port._
